Backup RAW thawed Wed 31 Mar, split Fri 2 Apr: enough cells to seed four groups.
IFNg, IL-4, LPS aliquots at working concentration. Plate maps checked before
Ligands for every axis. Antibody panel and viability dye. Escort the groups to
ELISA kits, Griess reagents, plate reader booked. Dilution series decided with
Plate reader. -20 space for supernatants. Seed rescue plates Fri PM for groups
that need the rescue path (see Legend).
Hoods: 2 groups per half day. Incubator shelves.
Cytometer: 2 slots of 2 h [TODO: facility]. Hoods.
One 24 h challenge arm only; the 6 h RNA arm belongs to the qPCR extension X01. A group that starts a step in the morning harvests it the next morning; pairs stay fixed within the week.
Facility slot: cytometer, facility lecture (fixed, reserved)
Wet lab Exp 1: establish the line (growth curve, freeze, re-thaw)
Wet lab Exp 2: polarize, challenge, read out
Dry lab and desk work: setup, analysis, planning
Poster and writing: introduction, significance, figures
